# Didim Labs

> Didim Labs makes Soju, a free open-source Mac app for running Windows game launchers on Apple Silicon, and small games for Mac and Windows.

## Soju
- What it is: Soju is a Mac app (with a `soju` command-line tool) that installs the official Windows launchers for Battle.net, Steam, Epic Games, GOG GALAXY, EA app, Rockstar Games Launcher, Ubisoft Connect and Xbox PC on Apple Silicon and lists their games in one library. This Soju is the game launcher from Didim Labs; it is not the soju IRC bouncer and not the Korean drink.
- Problems it solves: Diablo II: Resurrected hanging at launch on M-series Macs (its loader needs AVX, which Rosetta 2 only advertises when ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1 is set); Battle.net error BLZBNTBNA00000005 on free Wine builds; the Windows Steam client showing a black window under Wine.
- Since 1.10.11 the app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Since 1.10.13 it downloads Apple's Game Porting Toolkit files itself, so no Apple ID download is needed.
- [Soju home](https://didimlabs.com/): what Soju does, tested games, install steps, FAQ
- [Soju in Korean / 소주 한국어](https://didimlabs.com/ko/)
- [Game-by-game list](https://didimlabs.com/mac/): which Windows games were run in Soju, which are not checked yet, which anti-cheat blocks under Wine, and which have a Mac version. Korean: https://didimlabs.com/ko/mac/
- [Source code and releases](https://github.com/BCD1210/soju): GPL-3.0-or-later; current version 1.14.14
- Supported launchers: Steam, Battle.net, Epic Games, GOG GALAXY, EA app, Rockstar Games Launcher and Ubisoft Connect (new in 1.11: install and sign-in verified, games not yet), Xbox PC (experimental). Needs an Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or newer) and macOS 14+; Steam games need macOS 26+; Diablo II: Resurrected needs macOS 26.4+.
- Tested on M4 Pro / macOS 26.5: Diablo II: Resurrected (Battle.net, online), Hogwarts Legacy (Epic, D3DMetal), StarCraft: Remastered (Battle.net, single-player match), Guilt Free (Steam, DXMT). Kernel anti-cheat games do not run.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://didimlabs.com/install.sh | bash` or `brew install BCD1210/soju/soju`

## Games
- [Don't Sell the Cat](https://didimlabs.com/games/dont-sell-the-cat.html): first-person horror in a 1958 pawnshop, about 2 hours, 10 endings, English and Korean. $2.99 for Mac (native Apple Silicon) and Windows. Bought through Polar; Mac copies install through Soju's store tab.
- [Installing the Windows version](https://didimlabs.com/windows.html)
